name: 19110 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19110 (Philadelphia) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (77%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 19110 (Philadelphia) has 10 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
